# Enhancer for PW

> Free, open-source browser extension that supercharges Physics Wallah (pw.live) lectures.

## What It Does
- Watch lectures at up to 4.0x speed (with 0.1x precision)
- Auto-skip teacher silence and board-writing pauses
- 1-click Focus Mode to remove chat, doubt boxes, and AI popups
- Lock HD video quality (720p/1080p) automatically
- Real-time finish clock showing when your lecture will end
- Smart tab auto-pause (pauses when you switch tabs)
- Keyboard shortcuts: H (speed up), J (slow down), L (reset), Space (turbo boost)

## Availability
- Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ibepglcdcaanmkledmpgfapaffkhbadj
- Firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/enhancer-for-physics-wallah/
- Edge: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/pw-control/cnoboofnelihfmnjfbpbelpfdmogfaan

## Privacy
- 100% local — zero data collection, zero telemetry
- No audio recording — Skip Silence uses real-time RAM only
- No account access — never touches your PW login
- Open source under MIT License
